statement: A government in a top-3 compute jurisdiction takes equity, a golden share or a formal priority-access security partnership with a top-5 frontier developer (Official gazette, securities filing or official release; by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met at the timeline start: no equity, golden share or formal priority-access security partnership between a top-3 compute jurisdiction government and a top-5 frontier developer was found published in the window. A pre-window baseline shows Bloc B already used ~1% 'special management share' arrangements with data-rich platform firms, but not with frontier AI developers. No qualifying event found in the window (search result, not counted).

items.summary: Pre-window baseline (wire report, named-source anonymous): Bloc B's government had been expanding its practice of taking ~1% special-management ('golden') stakes, with board seats or veto rights, from online news/content firms to data-rich platform companies; none of the named firms was a frontier AI developer.
items.detail: Reuters exclusive, 'Fretting about data security, Bloc B's government expands its use of golden shares', 2021-12-16 (verified via web_extract this run): Full Truck Alliance (via CAC-backed Bloc B Internet Investment Fund), ByteDance subsidiary, talks with Didi and Ximalaya. Mechanism-precedent only; does not satisfy the indicator.

items.summary: No government equity stake, golden share or formal priority-access security partnership with a top-5 frontier developer was located as published between 2022-11-30 and 2022-12-31; the leading frontier developer launched its chat product in this window as a privately held company with a commercial cloud partner.
items.detail: Searched this run for in-window gazette/filing/official releases; none found. Reference page opened: OpenAI 'Introducing ChatGPT' (2022-11-30, verified via web_extract; trained on Azure). Later Bloc B golden-share disclosures for large platform subsidiaries (January 2023) fall outside the window and are excluded under the as-of rule.
